positions.title: Sales Advisor
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Managed cash transactions efficiently and upheld exceptional customer service standards as a Sales Advisor at H&M, thriving in a fast-paced environment requiring adeptness in handling customer queries and needs.

Applied strong visual and organizational skills to maintain store aesthetics and organization while meeting the demands of a dynamic retail setting at H&M, ensuring an inviting shopping environment.

Demonstrated capability in heavy lifting, contributing to seamless inventory management and ensuring the store's operational efficiency as a Sales Advisor at H&M.

positions.title: Freelance Video Editor
positions.description:
Channel & account growth  of more than 10,000+ views & 5,000 subscribers within 2 months (tiktok & youtube)
1 video per week with motion design, sfx, and special effects
Learned how the youtube & tiktok algorithm works to increase viewships & retain the viewer
Pushed out videos that were sent into editing in the set date along with a tik tok video to promote the video
Organized unfinished and finished videos on different folders to make the clients experience simple & easy

positions.title: Video Editor
positions.description:
Edited and synced 2 videos per month to music of my clients choice which took more than 4+ hours of editing
Organize schedules & videos with other team members in various projects to meet deadlines & keep our clients happy  
Managed the editing team to make our workflow the most efficient possible around tight schedules
Learned how to manage multiple things at a time around very tight schedules and deadlines
positions.insights: Skills: Video Editing · Adobe Premiere Pro · Motion Graphics · After Effects

positions.title: Video Editor
positions.description:
Edited 10+ videos a week with tight schedules & a variety of customers, but always made sure to meet my clients needs  expectations
Organized myself with no supervision to put out every clients video on time
Learned how to work & with different types of clients, always made sure to meet their needs even if we had different visions
positions.insights: Skills: Video Editing · Adobe Premiere Pro · Motion Graphics · After Effects
